ei.lesson: The Life of Jazz Pianist Bill Evans

fullPassage: American jazz pianist Bill Evans was born in New Jersey in 1929. His early training was in classical music. At the age of six, he began receiving piano lessons, later adding flute and violin. He earned bachelor's degrees in piano and music education from Southeastern Louisiana College in 1950. He went on to serve in the army from 1951 to 1954 and played flute in the Fifth Army Band. After serving in the military, he studied composition at the Mannes School of Music in New York. Composer George Russell admired his playing and hired Evans to record and perform his compositions. Evans became famous for recordings made from the late-1950s through the 1960s. He won his first Grammy Award in 1964 for his album Conversations with Myself. Evans' expressive piano works and his unique harmonic approach inspired a whole generation of musicians.

det.korean: 군 복무를 한 후에, 그는 뉴욕의 Mannes School of Music에서 작곡을 공부했다.
det.analysis: 전치사 After 뒤에는 동사 원형이 올 수 없고, 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)를 써야 합니다. 그래서 serve를 serving으로 바꿉니다. (After serving = 복무한 후에)
det.tip: 전치사(After, before, by 등) 뒤에 동사가 오면 반드시 동명사(-ing)로 씁니다 (serve → serving).

questions.passage: American jazz pianist Bill Evans was born in New Jersey in 1929. His early training was in classical music. At the age of six, he began receiving piano lessons, later adding flute and violin. He earned bachelor's degrees in piano and music education from Southeastern Louisiana College in 1950. He went on to serve in the army from 1951 to 1954 and played flute in the Fifth Army Band. After serving in the military, he studied composition at the Mannes School of Music in New York. Composer George Russell admired his playing and hired Evans to record and perform his compositions. Evans became famous for recordings made from the late-1950s through the 1960s. He won his first __________ in 1964 for his album Conversations with Myself. Evans' expressive piano works and his unique harmonic approach inspired a whole generation of musicians.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: Grammy Award(그래미상) — 그는 1964년 앨범으로 첫 그래미상을 받았다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Nobel Prize(노벨상): 음악 앨범 수상과 무관
❌ ② Academy Award(아카데미상): 영화 시상식
✅ ③ Grammy Award(그래미상): 원문 일치 ←정답. 음악 앨범으로 받는 상. 'won his first Grammy Award in 1964'
❌ ④ Pulitzer Prize(퓰리처상): 언론·문학 시상

questions.passage: American jazz pianist Bill Evans was born in New Jersey in 1929. His early training was in classical music. At the age of six, he began receiving piano lessons, later adding flute and violin. He earned bachelor's degrees in piano and music education from Southeastern Louisiana College in 1950. He went on to serve in the army from 1951 to 1954 and played flute in the Fifth Army Band. After serving in the military, he studied composition at the Mannes School of Music in New York. Composer George Russell admired his playing and hired Evans to record and perform his compositions. Evans became famous for recordings made from the late-1950s through the 1960s. He won his first Grammy Award in 1964 for his album Conversations with Myself. Evans' expressive piano works and his unique harmonic approach inspired __________ of musicians.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: a whole generation(한 세대 전체) — 그의 작품은 음악가들의 한 세대 전체에게 영감을 주었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a small group(소수 집단): 원문은 '전체(whole)'를 강조
❌ ② a large audience(많은 관객): 'of musicians'와 어색 — 관객이 아니라 음악가들
❌ ③ a new album(새 앨범): 'of musicians'와 연결 불가
✅ ④ a whole generation(한 세대 전체): 원문 일치 ←정답. 'inspired a whole generation of musicians'
det.tip: a whole generation of musicians = 음악가들의 한 세대 전체
